codex2 STRICT LOCAL SOURCE PREVIEW, d5c98a1d16e912a8609dcee1c441b59435b33de8 only; no forge attestation/claim/hold release.

P2 source compatibility finding: mcp.rs::tool_descriptors changes every ID pattern from ^[A-Z]+-\d+(-\d+)*$ to ^[A-Z]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9_]+)?-[0-9]+$ (e.g. show id7181, relationship fields7447/7459). This adds simple UUID nodes but narrows old accepted numeric-segment IDs: BUG-1-2-003 matched the old schema, is generated with legacy node_id='1-2' accepted by node::validate_node_id, and is readable by object_store::parse_spec_id and model alias lookup; the new schema rejects it. Schema-validating MCP clients therefore lose supported old-ID lookup/mutation even though core can still read it. Keep the legacy accepted grammar alongside opaque node support, and add published-schema regression for legacy numeric multi-segment and allowed hyphenated node aliases plus opaque nodes/cross-store rejection. Existing new schema test only checks one-node-segment examples. This is a concrete advertised-contract regression, not a claim that the server itself enforces JSON Schema or a live failure.

P2 required native evidence gap: tests/test_bug2017_bootstrap.py58-69 checks add response numbering and relationship tool success, but captures original object YAML only AFTER MCP operations at100. It never captures pre-MCP seeded META UUIDs/object set or asserts an expected references edge(source CLI BUG UUID -> target CLI FR UUID) after reloading. The later HOME loop compares whatever survived by line100 and whatever relationships already exist then; missing META rows or a relationship no-op could still satisfy it. Canonical advisor12:07 explicitly requires original CLI+seeded META UUID survival and actual source/target UUID relationship after restart, not response text/direct model test alone. Minimum decisive extension to the existing native contract: capture pre-MCP seeded/CLI UUID set, assert it survives both MCP adds, parse/reload the source after MCP closes and require expected target UUID edge; retain HOME comparison/idempotency. No new broad suite/framework. Existing work_binding::opaque_lowercase_ids_survive_full_save_and_keep_snapshot_cas is complementary repeated-save/stale-CAS proof, not native subprocess proof.

Already sent P1 legacy binding/provider migration validation finding separately (/tmp/codex2-pr2919-d5-early-finding.txt). Full source preview is finishing; no edits/build/tests performed, no author evidence promoted to independent pass. Final main merge/delta/fast/exact pushed-head CI and normal formal review remain required. Signed S3/1742/1843 boundaries retained.
subject: PR2919 d5 preview: legacy MCP schema + native assertion gaps
